narrative: During maintenance, a contractor entered the tank to inspect an internal valve. Gas testing was not recorded, the entry permit had expired, and no attendant was positioned outside.
Mechanical technician attempted to unbolt a pressurized gas line flange before closing isolation block valves. Stored energy was present without LOTO verification.
During rig operations, a roustabout was walking underneath the suspended load while the crane was slewing a 3-ton casing joint across the drill floor.
Warehouse helper noticed five empty wooden shipping pallets stacked unevenly behind store room and restacked them neatly against the exterior wall.
Discovered casing valve needle valve sheared off with 1200 psi shut-in casing pressure. Wireline grease injector unit was operating nearby without barrier.
Technician bypassed the high vibration emergency shutdown switch using an unapproved copper jumper wire to keep machine running during shift change.
Excavation contractor dug a 2.5 meter deep trench in water-saturated clay soil without trench shoring box or ladder egress while workers were inside laying pipe.
Electrician opened 415V MCC panel door with live busbars exposed while wearing cotton gloves. No arc flash PPE or calibrated multimeter voltage check performed.
Derrickman climbed from monkey board to crown block at 35m height without connecting twin lanyard fall arrest hooks to safety ladder cable sleeve.
Trailer truck loaded with drill pipes was driven at 70 km/h on unpaved slippery gravel road during heavy downpour without load strap tension re-check.
Operator climbed tank roof without portable H2S personal monitor or buddy system to take manual dip tape measurement while thief hatch was venting gas.
Welder was grinding steel pipe spool within 4 meters of solvent cleaning bench where open buckets of flammable degreaser solvent were stored without cover.
Greaser attempted to apply grease cartridge to walking beam bearing while pump jack counterweights were in active reciprocal motion. Sleeve caught momentarily.
Fuel gas supply pressure regulator to glycol reboiler malfunctioned, causing pilot flame failure with unburned hydrocarbon gas accumulating in firetube.
During 5000 psi hydraulic pressure test of wireline lubricator, quick-union connection backed off under pressure due to missing locking collar pin.
Contractor cleaned oil leaks around live 11kV step-up transformer using conductive metal scraper while adjacent radiator fan was rotating at high speed.
Caustic soda bags were dumped into mud hopper without full face shield or chemical rubber apron. Wind gust blew dry caustic powder toward worker face.
Maintenance crew opened manway bolts on flare drum without verifying upstream bypass valves were double-blocked and bled to atmospheric flare.
Operator started opening pig trap closure door hinge while bleed vent valve still showed 15 psi residual gas pressure inside barrel. Door swung violently.
Office clerk attempted to move three heavy steel four-drawer filing cabinets at once with top drawers fully loaded and open, causing cabinet to tip.
Workers were rigging up choke lines directly beneath the 18-ton BOP stack while it was suspended by hoist winches without mechanical safety latch locks engaged.
Technician drained LPG sampling cylinder into open concrete drain trough instead of closed flare recovery header, creating localized cold white vapor cloud.
Ambulance driver found brake pedal had low pressure during morning check. Master cylinder brake fluid was below minimum level; vehicle grounded for repair.
Pressure survey technician connected needle valve without safety whip check cable on high pressure 5000 psi flexible testing hose line.
Drill floor worker placed right hand directly on pipe tool joint while hydraulic roughneck iron roughneck was clamping at 45000 ft-lbs torque.
Isolation ball valve on 10-inch crude oil dispatch header was leaking at valve packing gland at 25 drops per minute near storm drain catch basin.
Technician dropped steel wrench across exposed 48V DC battery string terminals, producing heavy electrical spark and localized terminal melting.
Technician removed orifice plate carrier bolts on gas line without verifying that five-valve differential pressure transmitter manifold was equalized.
Roustabout pulled pipe stop pin before clearing workers from pipe rack ramp. Two joints of 5-inch drill pipe rolled uncontrolled down the ramp.
Discovered IBC plastic container containing 30% HCl acid bulging and leaking from bottom drain valve onto gravel floor without secondary containment bund.
Crew pulled gas lift mandrel valve with wireline while lubricator bleed valve was closed and 800 psi annular lift pressure remained active.
Mechanic was working inside mud pump fluid end while drive belts were not locked out. Remote driller console reset button was energized.
Welder struck electric welding arc on active crude flowline without obtaining hot work permit or verifying positive pressure crude flow inside pipe.
Rigger climbed 60-meter telecom tower without safety harness chin strap fastened and carried loose tools in open pocket rather than secured tool bag.
Four commercial 19kg LPG cylinders in camp kitchen were connected with degraded domestic rubber hose instead of high-pressure braided copper tubing.
Floorman placed foot onto rotating master bushing to kick slip handles while rotary table was turning at 40 RPM.
Found boom hoist wire rope had three broken strands and crushed core on primary winch drum during pre-dispatch annual statutory examination.
Contractor nitrogen pumping truck hose was connected to wellhead flowline without certified hammer union check valve or pressure relief valve installed.
Machinist operated lathe turning a 3-inch steel shaft while wearing long loose sleeve shirt and cotton work gloves near rotating chuck spindle.
Derrickman unlatched 90-foot drill pipe stand which kicked violently out of fingerboard due to wind gust; derrickman safety harness lanyard prevented fall.
Boiler attendant attempted to light boiler burner with manual torch after repeated flame failures without performing mandatory 5-minute furnace purge cycle.
Road tanker driver started engine and attempted to drive away from loading island while vapor recovery hose was still securely bolted to tanker dome.
Diesel transfer pump ground earthing wire was broken and disconnected from grounding rod while diesel was being pumped into generator service tank.
Contractor stepped directly onto fiberglass fan shroud cowling without crawl boards; cowling cracked under foot, worker caught handrail to prevent fall.
During well control drill, remote hydraulic choke valve failed to respond to control console lever because hydraulic accumulator pressure was depleted to zero.
Technician tightened armored level gauge glass bolts under full 450 psi operating gas pressure instead of depressuring and isolating gauge column.
Chemist was heating 200ml volatile crude sample on open electric hotplate instead of water bath inside certified fume cupboard; vapor flashed momentarily.
Driller slipped on wet oily steel grating outside doghouse door due to mud splatter from rotary table; no anti-skid coating was present on entrance step.
High pressure discharge manifold pulsation dampener was charged with compressed air instead of inert dry nitrogen, creating diesel explosion hazard.
Security guard inadvertently pressed emergency barrier raise button while OIL staff light vehicle was transiting over flush road plate.
